result_text:
I fixed the four broken default scoping conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. The `*Scoping*` tests pass. I didn't add tests for the new cases, and I didn't check that a pkgdown `.htm` page, a `<doc>` XML file or `build-gradle.js` now lands in the right scope.

- **HTML rules:** the pkgdown, Doxygen and `<meta name="generator">` rules had `(html|html|xhtml)`. They now use `(html|htm|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages match. `.html` and `.xhtml` still match.
- **Generated-code rules:** the `<doc>` XML rule and the `// Generated by …` JavaScript rule used `.*/[.]xml` and `.*/[.]js`, which only match a file literally named `.xml` or `.js`. They are now `.*[.]xml` and `.*[.]js`.
- **Gradle rule:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches.

Hand-written `.htm`, `.js` and `.xml` files stay out of these scopes because every rule except the Gradle one also requires its content pattern.

I ran the tests from the repo root with `-f` on the root pom, so they covered every module with a matching test class, not only `codeanalyzer`. I didn't commit.
